current_app_protection: Current app route files must be restorable from backup before any cleanup branch is promoted.
conflict_policy: If restore proof is missing, archive/delete is blocked.
checks: R2 Backup branch contains current app route files.
R3 Backup branch contains delete/remodel candidate source files.
R4 A file can be compared against backup.
R5 A file can be restored from backup if needed.
R6 Restore instructions are written before cleanup.
hard_rule: If restore is not proven, archive/delete is blocked.
